status_summary: H.R. 3467, introduced 2025-05-15 and referred to Ways and Means and Energy and Commerce, would from 2028 automatically enroll eligible beneficiaries in the lowest-premium Medicare Advantage plan, change the benchmark and risk adjustment and address hospice; bill status on GovInfo lists only introduction, referral and sponsor remarks in the Congressional Record on 2025-06-03, with no committee action recorded. H.R. 6114, introduced 2025-11-18, would instead bar HHS from using previously appropriated funds to make Medicare Advantage the default, and also shows referral only. CMS separately issued the CY 2027 Medicare Advantage final rule (published 2026-04-06, effective 2026-06-01), which rescinds several plan requirements, and the CY 2027 rate announcement, which keeps the 2024 risk model; these administrative steps do not count toward a legislative recommendation. No bill replacing the payment formula with competitive bidding or giving beneficiaries direct control of Medicare dollars was found.

timeline.event: H.R. 3467 (To amend title XVIII to reform the Medicare Advantage program) was introduced and referred to Ways and Means and Energy and Commerce; from 2028 it provides for automatic enrollment in the lowest-premium plan, capitated plan payment, a revised benchmark, claims-based risk adjustment and a hospice exception.
CMS published the CY 2027 Medicare Advantage and Part D final rule (effective 2026-06-01), rescinding several plan notice and analysis requirements and relaxing advertising and outreach rules.
CMS released the CY 2027 Medicare Advantage rate announcement: 2.48 percent projected payment increase, the 2024 risk model retained, audio-only and unlinked chart review diagnoses excluded.
